notes: No qal attested for this root; hiphil (the causative "treat with contempt" sense) is used as the primary/citation stem, with niphal as its natural passive counterpart -- same pattern as H6395 פלה earlier in this project. DEFAULT_STEM_OVERRIDE added ("קלה²": "hiphil") since niphal would otherwise be picked mechanically by STEM_ORDER.

Homonym check: shares consonants ק-ל-ה with H7033 ("to toast, i.e. scorch partially or slowly") and H7035 ("to assemble"), both unrelated roots. Requested gloss matches H7034 precisely ("to be light...but figuratively, only [causatively, hold] in contempt"); no cross-contamination found in the corpus tagging.

Retroactively renamed from the plain key "קלה" to "קלה²" when H7033 ("roast; parch; scorch") was added to the dataset as "קלה¹" -- true homograph, per the root-key superscript convention (lower Strong's number gets ¹).
